title: Chintamani Library v2.8.12 — Payment Verification, Portal Registration & Seat Matrix
releaseNotes: CRITICAL PAYMENT VERIFICATION FIX: Payment screenshots submitted via Universal QR Portal upload reliably to cloud storage, persist verification metadata, and reflect immediately in Admin → Payment Verification with high-res zoomable preview and in 6-month history.
UNIVERSAL QR REGISTRATION FIX: Fixed submit action, added live progress indicators, secure cloud image uploads, and automatic seamless transition to final fee payment stage.

SEAT MATRIX CLICK-TO-ASSIGN: Tap any available seat directly in the Seats Matrix to immediately assign it to any member with live search, automatic reallocation of previous seats, and real-time matrix refresh.
DOCUMENT VAULT IN DIRECTORY: Member details now permanently hold and display Aadhaar card (front & back) and photo images directly in Tab 1 with full pinch-to-zoom modal.
